app.title: Show HN: I Turned DOOM into a Transformer
app.author: falperc
app.description: A transformer trained on raw Doom replay data to generate plausible game actions.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and install dependencies
Run the inference script on a sample Doom episode
Validate that the predicted actions produce a valid gameplay sequence
Benchmark against a baseline random policy
